items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Kenny Devern in the context of Art Hodges working with him; the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond or provide any personal connection.

ctx.x: Yes. He's still in Chicago, isn't he, Art Hodges?
Yeah, as a matter of fact, he works near Washington at a place called the King of France Tavern in Annapolis about a couple of times a year with Kenny Devern and Don Michael.
